findings.claim: NXP 10-K 自述產業技術變化快、產品週期短、標準演進；需因應 AI/機器學習在裝置端執行的需求，並及時推出新產品，是競爭力關鍵因素。未點名具體替代技術。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: The semiconductor industry is highly competitive and characterized by constant and rapid technological change, short product lifecycles, significant price erosion and evolving standards.

findings.claim: Volkswagen 集團選 NXP S32K5 MCU 作為區域式（zonal）SDV 架構共用元件，首款車 2027 年；為 NXP 在新電子架構中被採用的證據（非替代威脅）。
findings.source: Embedded Computing: Volkswagen Group Announces Strategic Semiconductor Partnership with NXP
findings.excerpt: Volkswagen Group and NXP Semiconductors announced, ahead of the International Suppliers Fair (IZB) in Wolfsburg, a strategic partnership. NXP’s S32K5 family of microcontrollers (MCUs) will serve as a building block of Volkswagen Group’s future software-defined vehicle (SDV) architecture, supporting zonal control across all brands and vehicle

note: 搜尋未找到明確點名取代 NXP 核心產品的替代技術來源；第三方 Porter 分析頁（growthsharematrix.com）稱替代威脅低，但數字無法核實，未採用。搜尋摘要未提及 RISC-V 威脅。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
